verdict.rationale: Apify is a SaaS automation platform, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never shows an in-product assistant that users can hand tasks to. The MCP server and llms.txt let external agents use Apify, but that is integration with outside AI, not a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
